Alex Chen: Handoff for my shift — quick summary and routing notes.
Alex Chen: Ongoing items: saw a transient spike in /embeddings latency earlier at ~19:40 UTC, but it dropped after autoscale. No open incidents.
Alex Chen: Coverage gap tonight: I'm off at 23:30 UTC and no backup is scheduled 02:00–05:00 UTC (Americas overnight). We should cover at least a secondary for that window.
Alex Chen: Primary/secondary plan I suggest: Marco primary 23:30–03:30 UTC, Jess secondary 23:30–05:30 UTC. Marco, can you confirm?
Marco Ruiz: I can take primary until 03:30 UTC. I'll set my pager to route runtime and model-serving alerts to me.
Jess Liao: Happy to be secondary and field infra pages after 03:30 if Marco needs to hand off early.
Priya Patel: Quick routing clarification: which team owns pager for KV cache OOMs vs CUDA device faults? Runtime or infra?
Simon Brooks: infra-oncall here — CUDA device faults, node reboots, k8s node pressure -> infra. KV cache OOMs that are at model runtime layer -> runtime team. If an alert mentions 'model-cache' tag that's runtime.
Marco Ruiz: For clarity: I want runtime + model-serving errors (timeouts, prefix cache misses causing SLO breaches) routed to me. infra-oncall gets node/hypervisor/gpu-faults. sec-oncall gets pages that have attacker indicators (auth bypass, suspicious tokens)
sec-oncall: correct. Security only wants escalations when there's evidence of compromise or data exfil (use 'sec:escalate' tag). Otherwise, route to runtime/infra.
support-bot: FYI: customer-impact mapping in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/customer-impact (low/medium/high). Please tag customer IDs on any incident where >5% of requests fail.
Alex Chen: Runbook pointer: on-call checklist + handoff template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff. Follow the PD escalation steps when SLO >10% degraded for >10m.
Alex Chen: PD escalation snippet:
```
1) Notify secondary via PagerDuty
2) Post a short incident summary in #incidents
3) Run runbook step 'triage-root-cause'
4) If customer-impact high -> page support-oncall and product-ops
```
Priya Patel: If runtime sees persistent latency but infra shows GPU saturation, are we coordinated or should runtime open infra ticket? Prefer runtime to own initial triage and then call infra if hardware looks implicated.
Simon Brooks: Agreed — runtime collects logs and a stacktrace, if hardware tf-events present, open infra ticket and ping infra-oncall with link.
Marco Ruiz: Note: deployment version 2.3.1 is live on canary only; prod is 2.2.5. If you see errors referencing model-serving v2.3.1, likely canary noise.
Jess Liao: Also, the autoscaler config on prod has a smaller max-burst than expected; I've left a note in infra runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscaler-config
Alex Chen: Customer flags: account ACME-123 saw ~20% request DROPs during earlier spike. I added them to the incident checklist but we resolved before opening an incident. If it recurs, mark customer-impact = high and page support.
Marco Ruiz: I'll set an automated watch on ACME-123 with a short alert (5m sustained error rate >5%).
Priya Patel: One more, handoff etiquette: please include - what you were watching, any mitigations done, and your suggested next steps. Short bullets only.
Alex Chen: Final — assignments tonight:
- Primary (runtime): Marco Ruiz 23:30–03:30 UTC
- Secondary (runtime backup): Jess Liao 23:30–05:30 UTC
- Infra escalation: Simon Brooks (infra-oncall) reachable via PD
- Security escalation: sec-oncall (use sec:escalate tag)
- Support notification: support-bot will DM product-ops on high-impact incidents
Marco Ruiz: ack. I'll update my pager rules and post a quick status when I pick up the shift.
Jess Liao: ack.
Simon Brooks: ack — I'll be available for infra escalations.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Please run `/handoff-complete` and include the handoff checklist items when the shift starts. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Leaving detailed notes in my handoff doc at https://redwood.internal/notes/handoffs/1745009876
Priya Patel: Thanks Alex — good handoff.
Marco Ruiz: picking up now, will post status in 10.
